name: saddle
note: Art sample: the summit saddle of the Tsuzura-ori pass. Origin = the great camphor's trunk. x east, z south, heights in metres relative to the saddle crown. The home (hut, shrine, graves) sits under the camphor's crown; the land falls south to the plain with the ninety-nine bends, a rock spur (the lookout) over a ravine head, rice terraces on the gentler south-east bench; north of the saddle a gully with a spring at the foot of a south-facing rock face and a stream running east; cedars on the far side of the gully; bamboo on the east shoulder.
